title: Strength Training for Women Over 50
subtitle: How strength training for women over 50 affects long-term health, function, and prevention.
related_modules: WOM-115: Physical Activity for Cardiovascular Health in Women
evidence_strength: Established evidence from randomized controlled trials and meta-analyses supports strength training for women over 50 to improve muscle and bone health and reduce fall risk. Emerging evidence suggests additional benefits on cognition and metabolic health, though more research is needed. Safety and efficacy are well-documented when programs are appropriately designed and supervised.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
